title: ho mubarak aaj sardare jina paida hua
body:
ho mubarak aaj sardare jina paida hua
panjetan ke ghar imaame inso jaa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hazrate narjis hai shaadaa'n aur hassan hai shaad shaad
askari ka aaj ye roohe rawa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hogayi pehle nabuwat ab imamat qatm hai
ta qayamat ye imam ab hukm raa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
ay zameene saamera qismat hui teri buland
ghar me ahmad ke imam jab baarwah paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
saaqie kousar ka pota aagaya kousar lie
haa'n gule naqle imamat baarwa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
maahe shabane moazzam raat hai ye shabbe raat
roze jumma ye shahe kouno makaa'n paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
deen ki baaradari bhi aaj kaamil hogayi
hukmeraa'n apna imam ab baarwa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad rakh ab haazreene jashn ko tu aye kareem
uska sadqa aaj jo eemaa'n ki jaa'n paida hua
